article.story: ITHACA, N.Y. -- — DJ Nix and Gioacchino Panzini each scored 16 points in Cornell's 114-70 victory against Misericordia on Wednesday. Nix shot 5 for 5, including 4 for 4 from beyond the arc for the Big Red (4-2). Panzini was 6 of 6 and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line. Jake Fiegen added 14 points. Ace Varella scored 10 points to lead Misericordia. Eli Stoute and Nate Townsend added eight points apiece. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
